titles.title: By Any Means
titles.plot: Based on a true story, a young Black FBI agent (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II) is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa (Mark Wahlberg), he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur. When the system is broken, two men divided by everything agree on one thing: the law has limits. They don't.

titles.title: Come With Me
titles.plot: COME WITH ME follows Simon, a working class man who finds his life upended after suffering a traumatic home invasion. Compounded by trouble at his job and the loss of his best friend, and fueled by a rhetoric-spewing radio host, Simon begins a deadly descent into his own mind, trying to rectify the perceived wrongs and cleanse the injustice he starts to see in the world around him.

titles.title: Facing El Chapo
titles.plot: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss in this crime drama based on true events.

titles.title: I'm Game
titles.plot: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down. What follows is a thrilling ride filled with fun, surprises, action, and unforgettable moments must confront an evil far more powerful than he imagined to protect his family and survive the wedding that could seal their fate.

titles.title: Innocent Shots
titles.plot: When someone steals from their stash, two hustlers murder the thief. They soon find themselves in the midst of a growing street feud.

titles.title: Joe Cinque's Consolation
titles.plot: In 1997 an Australian university student injects her boyfriend with heroin at a dinner party. Despite the fact that the guests at the party knew her plan, no one warned him.

titles.title: Lost in the Sun
titles.plot: A small-time criminal (Josh Duhamel) bonds with an orphaned teen (Josh Wiggins) who serves as his accomplice in a string of robberies.

titles.title: No Man of God
titles.plot: In 1980, Ted Bundy was sentenced to death by electrocution. In the years that followed, he agreed to disclose the details of his crimes, but only to one man. During the early days of the agency's criminal profiling unit, FBI analyst Bill Hagmaier met with the incarcerated Ted Bundy in the hopes of understanding the psychology of the serial killer and providing closure for the victim's families. As Hagmaier delves into Bundy's dark and twisted mind, a strange and complicated relationship develops that neither man expected. Based on actual transcripts of interviews between FBI analyst Bill Hagmaier and the incarcerated Ted Bundy, No Man of God is nothing short of riveting.

titles.title: No One Killed Jessica
titles.plot: Tending bar at an elite event in Delhi, India, Jessica (Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub) refuses to serve three men after last call. One of the men, Manish (Neil Bhoopalam), who's the son of a big-time politician, shoots her in the head in response. There are dozens of eyewitnesses, but as Jessica's sister, Sabrina (Vidya Balan), discovers, they are either conveniently forgetful or willing to sell their testimony to the highest bidder, leaving an open-and-shut case hostage to greed and political influence.

titles.title: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai
titles.original_title: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai
titles.plot: After Assistant Commissioner Agnel Wilson (Randeep Hooda) unsuccessfully attempts suicide, he recounts his story of the Mumbai, India, underworld, which he'd been investigating for decades. It begins with the tale of Sultan Mirza (Ajay Devgn), a smuggler. Wilson attempts to take Sultan down through the gang leader's relationship with a Bollywood actress, but his attempt fails. Then a rising gangster, Shoaib Khan (Emraan Hashmi), overthrows Sultan -- but the power struggle is far from over.

titles.title: Pilgrims
titles.plot: Indre and Paulius travel to the small town where a gruesome crime was committed and they learn it is not as easy as expected to revisit the past.

titles.title: Sunrise
titles.plot: A psychological thriller set in Mumbai, in which a police inspector searches for his kidnapped daughter in the seedy world of child trafficking.

titles.title: The Child in Time
titles.plot: Stephen Lewis, a successful author of children's books, is confronted with the unthinkable when his only child disappears in a supermarket. Stephen and his wife, Julie, quickly find themselves torn apart by the loss.

titles.title: The Girl in the River
titles.plot: After twin teenage sisters are abducted -- one's body recovered from the Mississippi River, the other nowhere to be found -- veteran criminologist Alan Kramer (Devon Sawa) is drawn into a town suffocating under suspicion and fear. Working under relentless Police Captain Erica Graysmith (Tiffany Haddish), and forced to partner with Amelia Pembrock (Maggie Grace), a brilliant but untested profiler, Kramer quickly discovers this is no ordinary abduction. What begins as a local manhunt erupts into a media firestorm as chilling clues reveal a meticulous killer who plans every move with surgical precision and may be hiding in plain sight. Kramer and Pembrock must crawl inside the mind of a predator in a relentless race against time before another child is lost forever.

titles.title: Udta Punjab
titles.plot: The insurgence of substance abuse among the young in the Indian state of Punjab through the stories of a rock star, a migrant laborer, a doctor and a policeman.
